```artifact
Feature: Hospital Staff Information Acquisition and Feedback

Scenario Outline: Hospital Staff interacts with the system to acquire and provide feedback

  Given the system is operational
  When hospital staff accesses the system
  Then they should be able to acquire patient information
  And they should be able to provide feedback on the system requirements

Examples:
  | Role       | Information Source | Feedback Type | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Chemist    | Lab Results        | Positive       | Lab results are accurately reflected in the system |
  | Patient    | Medical History    | Negative       | Medical history is not fully captured in the system |
  | Lab Staff  | Test Results       | Edge          | Test results are partially reflected in the system |
  | Nurse      | Patient Observations | Invalid       | Observations are not recognized by the system |

Scenario Outline: Project Management and Development team analyzes and implements the system

  Given the system requirements are provided
  When the team reviews the requirements
  Then they should be able to analyze and implement the system

Examples:
  | Role       | Requirement Source | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Mishal     | Project Requirements | System is designed according to project needs |
  | Samyak     | Development Requirements | System is developed with necessary features |

```
